title: On the orthogonality of solutions for higher-order non-Hermitian difference equations
summary: In this paper we study higher-order difference equations which can be written as follows: $$ \mathbf{J} (y_0,y_1,...)^T = λ^N (y_0,y_1,...)^T, $$ where $\mathbf{J}$ is a $(2N+1)$-diagonal bounded banded matrix ($\mathbf{J}=(g_{m,n})_{m,n=0}^\infty$, $| g_{m,n} | 0$; and $g_{k,l}=0$ if $|k-l|>N$), $y_j$s are unknowns, $λ$ is a complex parameter, $N\in\mathbb{N}$. It is assumed that all $g_{k,k+N}$ and $g_{l-N,l}$ are nonzero.
